notes.title: New Year Update
notes.content:
Milestones Hit


 360 Degree Aiming Implemented 



 Combat Animations Added for Gang NPCs 



 NPCs Will Fully Sprint Away From You and Your Gang if Attacked / Robbed



 Grappling Mechanic 


Milestones Being Worked On


 Adding Female Gang NPCs



 Permadeath Function



 Destructible Items



 Player Drug Dealing 


What's Next?


 Demo


We should have a stable demo towards the middle of the new year. We hope you all are as eager to play it as we are to hear some feedback! 


 Future Updates for Launch


Before we are able to launch a quality game for you all to enjoy we will be expanding the map to a minimum of 3 districts on launch. We will also be adding in police responders, criminal fronts to build inside your extorted businesses such as drug dealing, arms dealing, fences, and protection rackets. 

There will also be a gender selection at launch so you can play as a male or female boss! 

There is plenty more in the works as well, we are looking forward to playing the finished product with you!

notes.title: Development Update / Updated Game Tags - Fleeing Mechanic, Next Steps
notes.content:
Development Progress

Below is the next to be completed mechanic in the game as well as what the next steps will be. If you want to follow along a bit more we will be interacting with our discord more here in the coming weeks so feel free to pop in and say hello! 

Brickhaven Discord 


 Fleeing Mechanic 


This mechanic sets it to where if you or your gang intimidate any of the citizens such as rob, shoot, or any other violent acts towards them, then they will flee from both you and your gang members. This sets the tone that you can absolutely set a mark in your turf. 

Next Steps

Below are the next stages of development we will be working on aside from the bug fixes.


 Combat


We will be enhancing the current combat mechanics across the board. 

First we will be enhancing the melee combat across the board. Threatened locals will begin to fight back against the robbing and violence if they are subjected to it. Some will flee but others will no longer stand for it.

Once this is completed we will focus on the shooting mechanics with the AI so that rival gang members will begin actually moving in on your turf. This will also lay the foundation for future updates!

Game Tag Changes


 Removed Tags


We removed the PVP tag for the time being as the multiplayer portion will take a bit longer to make than anticipated. We will be adding it in the future but did not want to mislead anyone to purchase the game on launch if we did not have it yet.

We are still planning on releasing a co-op mode on launch, the details of this are to be released! 

We also removed the steam workshop tag just until we prep the game for a state to be altered. 

Keep in mind, all removed tags will be added in the future, we just wanted to avoid any misrepresentation to buyers!

notes.title: Development Update - Shop Updates, NPC Behaviors, Rival Gang Members, Interiors
notes.content:
Development Progress

We appreciate you stopping by to check out our newest round of development updates! Check out the highlights below and feel free to pop in our discord server as well to be an active member of the Brickhaven community.

Brickhaven Discord 


 Interior Update 


We have added in interiors for a good portion of the buildings on the map. There are some that still need tweaking but we have the framework all setup! 


 Shop Updates


All buildings now have shop keeps and will be interactable as well as extortable. We will be adding in actual items players can purchase such as food, drinks, and other misc products as well in the future.


 NPC Behaviors


NPCs now follow along the sidewalks, use crosswalks, and will randomly go into some stores to keep the city feeling very much alive. We will be adding updated behaviors along these paths as well just to make sure the citizens aren't constantly hustling down the streets! 


 Rival Gang Members


Rival gang members will now spawn in the demo stage once released. We are fleshing out combat so that the rivals will be hanging around shops and popping in to challenge you and your crew. 

We appreciate everyone's interest! If you are interested in helping our project become what we intend it to be feel free to back us on Kickstarter as well :) We will be launching Kickstarter once we are confident it will be a success and then immediately getting you all your rewards so just bare with us!
